Hero.description: Technical consultancy for the confectionery industry, backed by production and operational experience across Türkiye, the Middle East and South Asia.
Hero.imageAlt: Gumdrop production on a confectionery production line

Services.description: Consultancy services focused on improving confectionery production processes, increasing operational performance and developing sustainable solutions to technical challenges.
Services.card1Text: Analysis of production processes, identification of bottlenecks and technical improvements aimed at increasing efficiency.
Services.card2Text: Systematic work focused on product standardization, process control and improving quality performance.
Services.card3Text: Analysis of technical problems encountered in production lines and processes, followed by the development of lasting solutions.
Services.card4Text: Technical evaluation and process development support for new production lines, products and factory projects.

About.name: A. Uğur Şahbaz
About.paragraph1: With extensive industry experience in confectionery production, process management and technical operations, he works on improving production processes and increasing operational efficiency.
About.paragraph2: Drawing on experience gained in different production environments across Türkiye, the Middle East and South Asia, he aims to develop practical and sustainable solutions to the technical and operational needs of businesses.

Experience.description: Experience gained across different production cultures and operational models is brought together with the goals of quality, efficiency and sustainable operations.
Experience.region1Text: Field and management experience in confectionery production, process development and technical operations.
Experience.region2Text: Technical and operational process experience across different facility structures and production cultures.
Experience.region3Text: Experience in process, implementation and operations management within international production environments.
Experience.scopeTitle: From technical expertise to measurable production outcomes.
Experience.quote: Every production facility is different. The solution lies in understanding the existing structure and aligning technical expertise with the real needs of the business.
